reasoningChain.evidence: I want to learn whether the rescued ranger provides a useful new way to progress.
The barricade militia has repeatedly appeared very weak, while the ranger has no combat evidence yet.
The ranger is a complete sustained single-target hero and already carries the purpose-matched rare bow.
I can replace the weak barricade militia while retaining the warrior, the proven mage, and the healer.
This replacement tests a new full hero in place of the weakest impression without removing my strongest damage or only healer.
In the next combat, the equipped ranger will contribute at least a noticeable share of team damage.

hypothesis.problem: The rescued ranger's practical contribution is unknown.
hypothesis.cause: The ranger is a complete sustained-damage hero and has a purpose-matched rare bow.
